sources.role: user directories, INI sections, controller binding syntax, memory-card/save-state naming and BIOS database

paths.path: ~/.local/share/duckstation/settings.ini ($XDG_DATA_HOME/duckstation; portable.txt beside the executable makes the program directory the user directory). Controller mappings are INI sections [Pad1]...[Pad8] and [Hotkeys], with keys named by the virtual control (for example Up, Cross, L1, L2, LLeft) and values parsed as Keyboard/<key>, SDL-<index>/Button<index>, SDL-<index>/+Axis<index>, SDL-<index>/-Axis<index>, or FullAxis variants; source serializes chorded bindings with ` & `.
memcards/ under the user directory by default (configurable via [MemoryCards] Directory); per-game cards may be selected by the game serial/title and shared cards use configured filenames
paths.naming: Default card names are <serial>_1.mcd / <serial>_2.mcd for shared cards; legacy/imported card formats include .mcr, .srm and .mc. The exact active name is controlled by the MemoryCards settings and card type.

paths.path: savestates/ in the user directory by default (configurable via [Folders] SaveStates)
paths.naming: <serial>_<slot>.sav for numbered slots and <serial>_resume.sav for resume; current source also creates backup/undo state data as part of save-state operations. Save-state screenshots are embedded in the .sav format, not a required sidecar.

paths.path: bios/ in the user directory by default (configurable via [BIOS] SearchDirectory); DuckStation's fast-boot/HLE options do not make a dumped BIOS universally unnecessary for all software
paths.naming: Canonical names in the source BIOS database include ps-10j.bin, ps-22a.bin, ps-22e.bin, ps-30a.bin, ps-30e.bin, ps-30j.bin, ps-41a.bin, ps-41e.bin, psone-44a.bin, psone-44e.bin and many PS2 BIOS names. Example authoritative MD5 values: ps-22a.bin 924e392ed05558ffdb115408c263dccf; ps-30a.bin 490f666e1afb15b7362b406ed1cea246; ps-30e.bin 32736f17079d0b2b7024407c39bd3050; ps-30j.bin 8dd7d5296a650fac7319bce665a6a53c. The database contains more regional/version-specific names and hashes; no single BIOS filename is valid for every region.
evidence: source:src/core/bios.cpp BIOS::ImageInfo database and hash values

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/DuckStation/settings.ini (portable.txt beside the executable switches to portable mode). Controller mappings use [Pad1]...[Pad8] and [Hotkeys] with Keyboard/<key>, SDL-<index>/Button<index>, SDL-<index>/+Axis<index>, SDL-<index>/-Axis<index> or FullAxis values; source serializes chorded bindings with ` & `.
~/Library/Application Support/DuckStation/memcards/ by default; [MemoryCards] Directory can override it
paths.naming: Per-game/shared memory-card names follow configured card type and serial, commonly <serial>_1.mcd / <serial>_2.mcd; imported formats may be .mcr/.srm/.mc.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/DuckStation/savestates/ by default; [Folders] SaveStates can override it
paths.naming: <serial>_<slot>.sav and <serial>_resume.sav; screenshots are embedded in the save-state file.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/DuckStation/bios/ by default; [BIOS] SearchDirectory can override it
paths.naming: Use source database names such as ps-22a.bin, ps-30a.bin, ps-30e.bin and ps-30j.bin; source records MD5 hashes, including ps-30a 490f666e1afb15b7362b406ed1cea246, ps-30e 32736f17079d0b2b7024407c39bd3050 and ps-30j 8dd7d5296a650fac7319bce665a6a53c. No one filename suits all regions.
